Candidate: The presenter has the same visible tied-back brown hairstyle, white cropped cardigan, gray halter-style top and gray shorts. The wider framing shows the gray padded bench and gray platform sandals. She smiles, looks down and raises one knee while adjusting a sandal. The pose, expression and framing differ from the reference. The background remains plain light gray.

The comparison describes visible appearance and wardrobe. It does not establish real-world identity.
